figurative_meaning_en: four times; much more than expected or calculated
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজের খরচ হিসাবের চারডবল হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: My age is four times yours.
The cost of this work turned out to be four times the estimated amount.
note: This idiom is a colloquial way to express multiplication by four, often used in informal speech to emphasize excess.
